scope: Application hardening with no new genuine Sandbox transaction, Live payment, payout, schema migration or hosted integration mutation.

connected.verificationMethod: The full run passed all 52 pre-existing checks and 8 of 16 new checks. Eight new checks initially failed on implicit-label selectors. Only four selector call sites were changed to accessible combobox roles. All 16 new checks then passed against unchanged application code.
